items.label: LS Marine Solution Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Installation fleet: payload of the cable-laying barge GL2030 being

set.signal: Installation fleet: the payload-capacity expansion of the cable-laying barge GL2030 (KRW 19,830 million conversion approved 03-25-2025; conversion period 2025.3-2026.3) is listed in the company history as completed in 2026.06. A new 13,000-ton-class cable-laying vessel (CLV) was ordered from the Tersan shipyard (Turkey) on 06-28-2025 for KRW 345.8 billion, delivery expected in Q2 2028; the company says the GL2030 barge cannot readily enter the European market and is limited in long-distance, high-capacity Asian lays, which the CLV is meant to overcome. The filing states the company plans to operate four cable-laying vessels in total by H1 2028, including the one under construction.
set.figure: New CLV 13,000 t payload, KRW 345,800,000 thousand; GL2030 payload expansion KRW 19,830,000 thousand

items.reason: The DART report never states GL2030 payload of 4,000 t or 7,000 t (7,000 t appears only in the later IR deck); 'being raised' contradicts the history line saying the expansion was completed.

items.label: LS Marine Solution IR presentation: KIND 19281 (09-09-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Company estimate of its West Coast HVDC opportunity: the offshore HVDC gri

set.signal: West Coast HVDC opportunity as presented in the IR deck: the offshore HVDC grid (8 GW as 525 kV 2 GW x 4 lines, 1,074 km, 2026-2038, first leg Saemangeum-Hwaseong targeted for 2030) has a total expected project cost of about KRW 122 trillion (the deck cites press reports from 2025.10 to 2026.5), and the company's own estimate - applying its existing methodology to the latest total project cost - puts HVDC subsea cable installation at about KRW 3.3 trillion (expected). The company describes itself as the only domestic company able to install West Coast HVDC subsea cable. Roadmap: business diversification in 2026 (SOV, power-cable maintenance), new vessel introduction and overseas expansion in 2028, completion of the energy highway phase 1 in 2030.

items.reason: Only the KRW 3.3T installation scope is the company's estimate; the KRW 122T total is sourced in the deck to compiled press reports, so the whole figure set should not be labelled 'company estimate'.
items.evidence: 출처 : '25.10~'26.5 보도자료 종합 ... 포설·시공 비중(50%)은 기존 추정 방법론을 유지하여 최신 총사업비에 대입한 추정치임 / 총 사업비 122조(예상) / HVDC 해저케이블 시공 규모 약 3.3조(예상)

items.label: Iljin Electric Q2 FY2026 (08-11-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Customer concentration: Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) was the only

set.signal: Customer concentration: Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) was the only customer above 10% of consolidated revenue in H1 2026 -- KRW 221,632,304 thousand, 19.38% (H1 2025: KRW 136,543,478 thousand, 13.93%). In the parent-only accounts the US subsidiary ILJIN Electric USA took KRW 92,687,260 thousand (8.26%). KEPCO-related risk: a public-sector bid-participation restriction and cancellation of qualified-supplier registration for some 170kV breakers over the KEPCO 170kV GIS bid-rigging case (Iljin's 2024 sales to that public-sector customer were KRW 269,528,705,721) remain suspended by court order until 30 days after the first-instance ruling in the administrative suit, and a criminal trial under the Fair Trade Act is in progress.

items.reason: The filing gives Iljin's own sales TO the customer (해당 거래처에 대한 매출액), not the customer's sales to Iljin; suspension term stated precisely.
items.evidence: 해당 거래처에 대한 매출액 : 269,528,705,721원 ... 행정처분 취소소송 제1심 판결 선고일로부터 30일이 되는 날까지 처분 효력의 정지
